title: Continuity of School Financial Assistance when Students are Posted from One School to Another
what_it_is: Continuity of School Financial Assistance when Students are Posted from One School to Another

sections.label: MOE Financial Assistance Scheme
sections.summary: MOE FAS supports lower-income Singaporean students yearly, continues after school transfers, and allows graduating students to apply for their next school.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS), which provides support for Singaporean students from lower-income households, is provided for one year at a time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This allows support to be reviewed and adjusted as family circumstances vary with time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students under MOE FAS continue to receive support, if they transfer across schools in the course of the school year, without having to re-apply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For graduating students who wish to apply for financial assistance in the school they will be progressing to, they can make an FAS application in their current school towards the end of the graduating year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: If the application is successful, the students will receive the FAS support in the school they will be progressing to.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: To support students progressing into our Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs), MOE also shares with Institute of Technical Education (ITE), the Polytechnics and the Autonomous Universities (AUs) the list of former MOE FAS recipients who are posted to them.

sections.label: ComCare and school-based FAS
sections.summary: ComCare through SSOs facilitates financial assistance applications and school-based FAS help, and MOE directs funds to schools for school-based FAS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In other words, if the resident that Dr Tan Wu Meng mentioned approaches ComCare, ComCare, through SSOs, would actually facilitate an application through the SSOs for financial assistance, as well as help with the application for school-based FAS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The other point I wanted to mention on school-based FAS is, the specific example that Dr Tan had mentioned was because the student was a graduating student in Primary 6 and would be posting to a Secondary school or another school, and perhaps, at that point in time, it was not yet clear which school the student would be posted to.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But I would just like to assure the Member that the MOE directs funds specifically towards the schools to administer school-based FAS, which is over and above the MOE FAS that I was talking about.
